raw_goal: I want to learn about the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem to build my own MCP server. I want papers that present applications, use cases, or domain-specific MCP server implementations — concrete examples of MCP being deployed (e.g., MCP for code analysis, MCP for scientific workflows, MCP for healthcare data, MCP for enterprise tools). I want to see what kinds of problems people are solving with MCP. Not interested in: papers that only mention MCP in passing as one of several agent frameworks, MCP security/attack papers, or pure MCP protocol-design proposals without an application

distilled_criteria.text: Paper explicitly presents a concrete MCP server implementation or application (e.g., code analysis, scientific workflows, healthcare, enterprise tools).
Paper's primary contribution is a use case or domain-specific deployment of MCP, not a general agent framework or protocol design.
Paper does NOT focus on MCP security, attacks, or vulnerabilities.
Paper does NOT mention MCP only in passing as one of several agent frameworks.
Paper includes implementation details, evaluation, or case study of the MCP server in a specific domain.

lexical_query: Model Context Protocol MCP server implementation application domain-specific use case
